payload.reason: The evidence specifies the datasets used for training classifiers in sentiment analysis, including features derived from tweets and their corresponding sentiment values.

claims.text: The model is trained using aggregate sentiment values from tweets and stock price movements as features and outputs, respectively.
The classifier is trained on Word2vec representations of human annotated tweets, with a training split of 90% of the dataset.
The model also utilizes N-gram representations of the same dataset for training.
